BiblicalUsage: Him that pisseth against the wall is the phrase the prophets use for every male of a doomed house. Jeroboam, Baasha, and Ahab all hear it: I will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel. David swears it against Nabal, and Jehu fulfils it against Ahab.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the crude phrase is deliberate, total judgment with no male left, for the house is cut off to the last man, and I hold that God's judgment, when it comes, is thorough.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
